quote: In addition to its correlation with disease behavior, bowel thickness, and the presence of intestinal granulomas and creeping fat, increased mesenteric lymphatic vessel density in the proximal margin is predictive of early clinical recurrence after surgery in patients with Crohn's disease.
summary: D2-40-stained mesenteric lymphatic vessel density was higher in Crohn's disease and predicted postoperative recurrence.

quote: Lymphatic vessels are present within the lamina propria of colon in pathologic states, including cases of intramucosal carcinoma.
summary: D2-40 staining found lymphatics in the lamina propria of inflamed and neoplastic colon but not in normal colon.

quote: TWEAK elevated surface expression of activated fibroblast markers and adhesion molecules (podoplanin [PDPN], ICAM-1, and VCAM-1) and secretion of IL-6, CCL2, and CXCL10.
summary: TWEAK raised surface PDPN along with ICAM-1 and VCAM-1 on primary colonic fibroblasts; PDPN is one of several markers.

quote: Fibroblast subsets (CD45-PDPN+) based on the expression of CD34/CD90 or FAP/CD90 were identified in all patient samples, and some populations correlate with the percentage of immune cells or clinical scores.
summary: PDPN is used as a fibroblast marker in osteoarthritis synovium; unrelated to UC.
PDPN here abbreviates painful diabetic peripheral neuropathy, not podoplanin.

quote: IF analysis confirmed higher levels of MMP13 in stenotic tissue sections of CD patients and demonstrated αSMA+ and Pdpn+ fibroblasts as a major source.
summary: Pdpn marks fibroblasts that produce MMP13 in stenotic Crohn's tissue; the paper tests MMP13, not PDPN.

quote: We reviewed their clinical presentation, disease associations, and staining of slides with CD68 in all cases, D2-40 in 5 cases, and HLA-DR in 4 cases.
summary: D2-40 was used as a lymphatic stain in skin biopsies of intralymphatic histiocytosis; unrelated to UC.
NES here means nuclear export signal in MSH3, not KLK10.

quote: The survival advantage conferred by KLK10 overexpression could be recapitulated with the exogenous administration of a recombinant KLK10.
summary: KLK10 overexpression in ovarian cancer cells reduced tumorigenicity and prolonged mouse survival, suggesting tumour-suppressor activity; no colitis data.

quote: The major genes in the down-regulated categories included Slc9a5, klk10, Fgf15, and Alpi, whereas the major genes in the recovered categories were Cyp2b2, Ace, G6pc, and Setbp1.
summary: Klk10 is one of several genes altered in rat colon in constipation and laxative treatment; unrelated to UC.

quote: A 9-gene signature-based risk predication model was established via regression analyses, and the model-based risk score was formulated as: Riskscore = (-0.1214) * TNFRSF11A + (-0.2617) * TMEM97 + (-0.1041) * LGR5 + 0.0973 * KLK10 + 0.1655 * HOXB8 + 0.227 * FKBP10 + (-0.1312) * CXCL13 + (-0.1316) * CXCL10 + 0.2593 * CD36.
summary: KLK10 is one of nine genes in a colon cancer prognostic risk score; no UC data.

quote: Using loss- and gain-of-function mouse models, we show that SAA1, SAA2, and SAA3 have distinct systemic and local functions in promoting Th17-mediated inflammatory diseases.
summary: SAA proteins including SAA2 drive pathogenic Th17 differentiation and promote Th17-mediated inflammatory disease in mouse models.

quote: SAA1 and SAA2 are inducible by inflammatory cytokines, whereas SAA4 is constitutively produced.
summary: Review of serum amyloid A variants, noting SAA2 is cytokine-inducible and SAA is a marker in many diseases.

quote: This might partially explain the observed increase in susceptibility of DKO mice to DSS colitis.
summary: SAA1/2 double knockout mice are more susceptible to DSS colitis, SAA1/2 overexpression reduced E. coli viability, and SAA1/2 RNA was higher in Crohn's colon.

quote: SFB produces the quorum-sensing AI-2 and promotes the production of SAA1 and SAA2 by the host, which increases T helper 17 (Th17) cell production.
summary: Gut bacteria raise intestinal SAA1 and SAA2 and Th17 cells in a mouse depression model; no colitis outcome.

quote: Both genes are induced modestly by TNF-alpha and IL-6 alone and synergistically by TNF-alpha plus IL-6.
summary: SAA1 and SAA2 promoters respond to TNF-alpha, IL-6 and glucocorticoids in hepatic and epithelial cell lines.

quote: Both male and female Saa3(-/-) mice had reduced liver Saa1 and Saa2 expression in association with reduced plasma SAA.
summary: Saa2 liver expression fell in Saa3 knockout mice on an obesogenic diet; the paper concerns SAA3 and obesity, not colitis.

quote: The interaction crosstalk between the intestine and the mesentery has been described in this review, and the expression of mesentery-derived SAA2 is upregulated during IBD, which contributes to immunoregulation of macrophage.
summary: Review of monocyte-macrophages in IBD noting that mesentery-derived SAA2 is upregulated in IBD and contributes to macrophage immunoregulation.

quote: Although L. intestinalis exerts no direct effect on T cell differentiation, it decreases C/EBPA-driven gut epithelial SAA1 and SAA2 production, which in turn impairs Th17 cell differentiation.
summary: A probiotic lowered epithelial SAA1/SAA2 production in DSS colitis, linked to reduced Th17 differentiation; SAA2 itself was not directly perturbed.

quote: Many acute-phase proteins were up-regulated early in murine cutaneous GVHD including serum amyloid A2 (SAA2), SAA3, serpins a3g and a3n, secretory leukocyte protease inhibitor, and metallothioneins 1 and 2.
summary: Saa2 is one of several acute-phase genes up-regulated in mouse skin graft-versus-host disease; not related to UC.

quote: The neural network classification narrowed down candidate biomarkers to 5 proteins (SAA2, APCS, APOA4, F2 and AMBP) that had maintained accuracy which could discern early (I/II) from late (III/IV) stage CRC.
summary: SAA2 is one of five plasma proteins selected as candidate colorectal cancer stage biomarkers; not a UC study.

quote: In humans the major acute phase SAAs comprise a group of closely related variants of SAA1 and SAA2.
summary: This paper studies purified recombinant SAA1 activity on leukocytes; SAA2 is only named as a related variant.

quote: In dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis, SAA3 is the predominant isoform of inducible SAA proteins that also include SAA1 and SAA2, and mice with genetic deletion of Saa3 exhibits increased production of proinflammatory cytokines, decreased expression of IL-22 along with aggravated epithelium disruption, and reduced colon length compared with wild-type littermates.
summary: SAA3, not SAA2, is the isoform deleted and shown to protect against DSS colitis; SAA2 is mentioned only as another inducible isoform.

quote: Signature alterations in host proteins (e.g., SAA2 and GOLM1) and microbes (e.g., Alistipes and Streptococcus) are further imprinted in serum and fecal samples as potential diagnostic biomarkers, thus providing a rationale for precision diagnosis.
summary: SAA2 is among host proteins altered in Crohn's disease tissues and detectable in serum and feces as a potential diagnostic biomarker.

quote: The hub genes, including dual oxidase maturation factor 2 (DUOXA2), serum amyloid A (SAA) 1 and SAA2, TNFAIP3-interacting protein 3 (TNIP3), C-X-C motif chemokine (CXCL1), solute carrier family 6 member 14 (SLC6A14), and complement decay-accelerating factor (CD antigen CD55), were revealed as potential tissue biomarkers for UC diagnosis or treatment.
summary: SAA2 is one of several hub genes from UC expression data proposed as tissue biomarkers; no separate SAA2 analysis.
